title: fx: a Zig coding agent shaped like a Unix command, interactive, one-shot, or WebAssembly
description:
fx is a compact coding agent written in Zig, shaped more like a Unix command than a terminal IDE. It can run interactively, answer one-shot requests, resume saved sessions, or embed inside another application as a native binary or WebAssembly module. Skills, MCP tools, subagents, and scoped permission rules extend the core without changing its shell-like interface.  #github #opensource 

https://github.com/vercel-labs/fx
